name: Sunday Hotel Arshika Sunset Road
detail: The room is spacious, suitable for a small family, the pool is directly in front of the room, the room is clean, the swimming pool is clean, it is not noisy, and there is hot water.

name: Palette Resort Argya Santi Jimbaran
detail: The room is aesthetic, clean, and has a beautiful private terrace. It is located in a strategic area near Unud Jimbaran and the culinary center. Important notes: Access & Parking: The entrance road (Max Adam) is a bit rocky. Basement parking is limited (only 4-5 cars), so it's highly recommended to bring a motorcycle. Cleanliness: The bathroom was a bit sandy upon entering, perhaps because it hasn’t been used for a while, but other areas are fine. Ideal for those looking for a calm and green atmosphere in Jimbaran! 😉🌿🌳

name: Palette Signature Hotel
detail: Although it's older than the images, the minimum conditions for staying are met. I was concerned about the lack of facilities and the smell of sewage. However, the room was spacious, there was a pool, it was close to the bus stop, and above all, the smiles of the staff were wonderful.

name: Kuta Paradiso Hotel
detail: The charm of the Kuta Paradiso Hotel lies in its perfect combination of location, facilities, and cost performance. First, the location boasts overwhelming convenience, situated in the Golden Triangle of Kuta's city center, less than a one-minute walk to the beach, and close to Waterbom and Discovery Mall. For travelers who want to enjoy sightseeing and shopping efficiently, having almost no stress in mobility is a significant advantage. Next, in terms of facilities, it offers resort-level amenities such as a large pool, spa, gym, and kids' club, allowing guests to enjoy a resort feel while being in the city. Additionally, the breakfast buffet is diverse, receiving high praise for accommodating specific requests like egg dishes and bacon. The guest rooms are spacious and comfortable, and the option to choose pool or ocean views is also appealing. Although the price range is moderate, considering the location and facilities, the cost performance is exceptionally high, gaining support from a wide range of guests, from families to couples and first-time visitors to Bali.

name: Bintang Kuta Hotel
detail: It is located in Kuta, about a 10-minute drive from the airport, surrounded by many hotels. This hotel does not have balconies in any of the rooms, but the rooms are clean and nice. The breakfast area is small and offers a buffet, but a variety of dishes are available. It's similar to the breakfast offered at Japanese chain business hotels. It is adjacent to the neighboring Bintan Resort Hotel, which is part of the same hotel chain, so you can also use the pool at this hotel facing the beach. There are many restaurants, cafes, street stalls, and massage shops nearby, making it lively. The hotel staff is also friendly. It is a very convenient and reasonable hotel for when you're coming in or out of the airport.

name: Palm Beach Hotel & Resort
detail: Review: - **Location and access**: Strategically located near the beach with easy access to the city center. Ample parking that is easily accessible from the main road. - **Rooms and comfort**: Rooms are quite spacious with comfortable beds and complete basic amenities. Sea/pool view (depending on the room type) adds extra value. - **Public facilities**: Clean swimming pool, comfortable sun deck area, restaurant offers a selection of local and international menu, and breakfast with a good variety. - **Customer service**: Friendly staff, quick response to additional requests such as extra towels or room needs. - **Value for money**: Overall, worth it for a 3-star class with adequate facilities and an attractive location. - **Improvement note**: The pool should be filled with fish; it has been three days since I checked in and there are no fish yet. This could become a breeding ground for mosquitoes, especially dengue mosquitoes, which pose a danger to guests.

name: EDEN Hotel Kuta Bali
detail: We had a really nice stay here. The room was spacious, comfortable, and very clean. The staff were all polite, friendly, and helpful, which made our stay even more enjoyable. There’s also a nice indoor pool, which was great. The only small downside is that the pool bar closes a bit early, but I completely understand. Overall, it was a great experience and definitely good value for money. The hotel was clean, comfortable, and well maintained. I’d be happy to stay here again!

name: Grand Whiz Hotel Nusa Dua
detail: The Westin Hotel is a 15-minute walk away. Every morning, I was able to walk to work along the jogging course on the beach. The staff were very friendly and promptly addressed my requests, so I could rest comfortably when I returned to my accommodation after work. The Wi-Fi was also not slow, so it didn’t hinder my work. The accommodation felt a bit old, but it was not dirty since they cleaned diligently. However, the desk was slightly damaged, which made me feel uneasy while working. A lizard did come into the room, but it didn’t climb onto the bed and stayed in the corner, so it didn’t bother me. The swimming pool was very large and long, so I wanted to stay there on vacation next time and go swimming. The breakfast was simple but included fresh fruit, warm porridge, and a delicious omelet that the staff kindly prepared.

name: Kutabex Beachfront Hotel
detail: Staying from September 13-17, 2026, the room is spacious, the air conditioning is cold, clean, and comfortable with a large bed. There is a refrigerator, and it is close to Kuta Beach, 50m away. The hotel is highly recommended, you won't regret it with affordable prices and star quality. In Kubex, there is a band every day, and the swimming pool offers a sunset view.
